messages.subject: Problem Loading Large Model
parts:
I have been loading a large dataset of about 30,000 rows into Rattle.  I ran several models including a random forest one and an svm.  I save the Rattle project, and when I reload it, the data won’t show up (the data tab just shows a blank), and I get the message in the R console:

 

“Error in if (file.exists(uri2file(crs$filename))) theWidget("data_filechooserbutton")$setUri(crs$filename) else crs$filename <- basename(crs$filename) :   argument is of length zero”

 

If I load the data and run only one of the models, save it and reload it, it works fine.  I have tried this in both the 32 and 64 bit versions of R and still get the same problem.

 

Does anyone have any idea what might be causing this?

messages.subject: Re: Problem Loading Large Model
parts:
This looks like a Rattle bug but I can't see the problem yet - do you think it depends on the size of the data? One of the arguments, probably around the file.exists and uri2file, is getting to be NULL and thus failing. Once I have a reproducible example I will debug it.

Regards,
Graham
